description.value: Alberni Co-op is a member-owned co-operative serving Port Alberni on Vancouver Island, part of the Western Canadian Co-operative Retailing System. The convenience store arm of the co-op offers everyday supplies to residents and travellers passing through the region. As a co-operative, it is community-owned and focused on serving local needs.
